summary.text: Crystal Lett is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 11 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She works as a mental health professional.

paragraphs.text: Crystal Lett was born in Columbus, Ohio, and earned a bachelor's degree from Ohio State University in 2008.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a mental health professional.
Lett assumed office in the Ohio House on January 1, 2025, and is ranking member of the Children and Human Services Committee.
She was unopposed in the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Shawn Kaeser in the general election.
